invariant: EVERY ASSISTANT tool_use THAT IS FOLLOWED BY ANOTHER CONVERSATION TURN MUST RECEIVE A CORRESPONDING tool_result IN THE IMMEDIATELY FOLLOWING USER CONTENT BEFORE ANY ORDINARY USER TEXT OR SUBSEQUENT ASSISTANT TURN.

implementation.what: validateToolUseProtocol(messages) pure validator (generic over tool names) + ToolProtocolViolationError (provider-shaped error for scripted clients).

what: toolResultsForAssistantTurn(toolUseBlocks, resolve): the single helper that builds the user reply to any assistant turn containing tool_use blocks - exactly one tool_result per tool_use, in order, nothing else; both continuation branches (evidence tools; retrieval nudge) use it.
RETRIEVAL_NUDGE_TEXT delivered as the tool_result content of the provisional submit_compilation call (policy wording unchanged, prefixed 'NOT YET ACCEPTED - provisional submission evaluated').

heldProvisional: the parsed provisional submission is kept when the nudge is issued; retainingHeld() returns it (with the model's own sufficiency values) under PROVIDER_FAILURE / TOOL_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED / MODEL_SCHEMA_FAILURE if the continuation ends without a new submission - never null, never promoted.
Pre-send guard: validateToolUseProtocol(messages) before every stream call; a violation throws inside the same try so it is classified with transport failures and cannot discard held work.

genericOrSubmitSpecific: Generic. The helper and validator treat submit_compilation as an ordinary tool_use for protocol purposes; the only submit-specific logic is WHAT the tool_result says (the nudge), which is the semantic role the tool genuinely has under the 3B.1 policy.
notChanged: nudge condition and its once-only semantics
verifier, reconciliation, inventory, source coverage, structural parser, quantitative scanner, precedent
falseCompleteness: None introduced: a retained provisional submission always carries a non-null failureReason (compile.ts -> REVIEW_REQUIRED at best) and its rules/definitions keep the sufficiency the model stated (UNSUPPORTED/MISSING_CONTEXT -> UNSUPPORTED_SEMANTICS/MISSING_CONTEXT failure reasons).

found: retrieval-nudge branch (the defect): assistant tool_use -> plain user text
post-nudge terminations discarding the held submission: transport failure (catch), turn ceiling (TOOL_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED), corrective-reminder exhaustion (MODEL_SCHEMA_FAILURE)
inspectedAndAlreadyValid: evidence-tool branch (always emitted one tool_result per tool_use)
corrective reminder after a plain-text turn (no tool_use in that assistant turn, so plain user text is legal)
distinctMechanismsNotFixed: compile.ts maps a caller PROVIDER_FAILURE with a retained submission to REVIEW_REQUIRED via the generic failureReasons path; no dedicated 'transport failure after provisional submission' status exists (reported, not addressed - not a protocol defect).
